m: taijasa mf(ī)n. originating from or consisting of light (tejas), bright, brilliant, ŚBr. xiv; MāṇḍUp.; MBh. &c.
consisting of any shining substance (as metal), metallic, ĀśvGṛ.; Gaut.; Mn.; KātyŚr., Sch.
said of the gastric juice as coloured by digested food, Suśr. i, 14
passionate, Sāṃkhyak.; Tattvas.; Vedāntas.; Suśr.; BhP.
N. of a Tīrtha, MBh. iii, 7035; ix, 2723
a: taijasa a. (sī f.) [tejaso vikāraḥ aṇ] 1 Bright, splendid, luminous; U. 2. 12. 2 Made up or consisting of light; taijasasya dhanuṣaḥ pravṛttaye R. 11. 43. 3 Metallic. 4 Passionate. 5 Vigorous, energetic. 6 Powerful, intense. — saḥ The highly refined or subtle essence (Vedānta phil.). — saṃ 1 Any metal. 2 Ghee. 3 Intensity, severity. 4 Vigour, energy, might. Comp. — āvartanī a crucible.
